why: A cartoon meeting room emptying out. A manager touches Sam's shoulder, and the comment appears as a speech bubble above Sam, who grins and nods while Priya gathers her notes behind him.
The same meeting room, one week later: Sam's hand is up mid-sentence as Priya's speech bubble is cut off. The old comment bubble fades to grey beside it.
The cartoon Sam slowly turns into a silhouette of the viewer at their own desk, holding a similar nice-but-empty comment bubble.
The comment bubble sits large. A warm glow labelled with the feeling appears on the left; on the right an empty hand reaches towards the bubble and finds nothing to grip.
The presenter turns towards the frozen meeting scene, gesturing at the comment bubble, as if inviting the viewer to work on it together.
The word dominating is stamped on Sam's chest as a label. Sam's cartoon arms fold and his face tightens, a defensive wall rising between him and the speaker.
The vague bubble morphs word by word into the new comment over the replayed scene, with the words spoke over Priya highlighted as Sam's bubble overlaps Priya's. The label stamp peels off Sam.
The rewritten comment holds still on screen with a blank, dashed gap after it. A slow pulse on the gap while the viewer thinks.
The dashed gap fills with the effect, highlighted. In the scene, Priya's half-finished bubble hangs with a trailing break, and the earlier version fades behind the new line.
A third highlighted slot opens at the end of the comment. A long scrolling to-do list shrinks to a single line as Sam and the speaker sit side by side, the step shared between them.
The complete comment sits large over the meeting scene, its three parts in three calm colours that light up one at a time as each is read. The vague first version is a faint ghost behind it.
The three coloured parts lift off the comment and line up as three labelled tiles, with a few faint blank tiles of other shapes sitting dimly beside them.
A small new cartoon scene of Dev at a call with an empty agenda slot, above three answer cards that slide in one by one as each is read, no answer marked.
Card B lifts forward and gets three ticks, one per question, as its behaviour, effect and step parts light up. A and C slide back.
Card C comes back with its behaviour and effect parts ticked, then the phrase be more prepared is circled with a blank third tick beside it.
A desk calendar with a single sticky note reading a vague comment; a pen crosses it out and starts the same three coloured slots beneath it.
A before and after split of the same meeting scene, then a simple timeline to next week: Sam waits with his hand lowered while Priya's bubble completes in full.
The presenter holds up three fingers, one at a time, with the three short phrases appearing beside them over the calm meeting room.
